#  44410 - Chemical Reaction Engineering Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **44410 - module is no longer offered from WS 2013/14**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Chemical Reaction Engineering**  |  
|  Grundlagen der Chemischen Verfahrenstechnik   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 4 - Environmental Sciences and Process Engineering   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. Dr.-Ing. Schnitzlein, Klaus 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every winter semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | Solving reaction engineering problems by knowing the fundamentals and their applications  |  
| Contents:  | Concepts and Definitions, Stoichiometry, Chemical Thermodynamics, Kinetics, Design of Ideal Reactors, Multiple Reactions, Analysis of Nonideal Reactors, Operation of Chemical Reactors  |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | 
  * Heat and Mass Transfer
  * Thermodynamics

 |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Lecture / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Exercise / 1 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Practical training / 1 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 120 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | 
  * Fogler, H. S., Elements of Chemical Reaction Engineering, Prentice-Hall International, 2nd edition 1992
  * Levenspiel, O., Chemical Reactor Design and Operation , J. Wiley1972
  * Missen, R.W. et al., Chemical Reaction Engineering and Kinetics, J. Wiley 1999
  * Sandler, S.I., Chemical and Engineering Thermodynamics, J. Wiley 1989

 |  
| Module Examination:  | Unspecified - Specification from winter semester 2016/17 required!  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | 
  * Short tests
  * Lab reports
  * Written examination (120 min)

 |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  | **No offer in winter semester 2013/14!**  |  
| Module Components:  |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |
